summary: Shared macros now update on their own, so you always run the latest published version of a macro loaded from the shared macro library.
details: Opening the Macros panel replaces every loaded macro the library holds a newer version of and names the updated macros in the status bar.
Running a macro, from the panel or a Flight Deck button, checks the library once more and runs the newest version.
A local copy you edited at the same or a higher version is left alone; the yellow Update stamp is gone because there is nothing left to click.
